summary: Walks a linked list rooted at the head pointer in this[9] (this+0x24), following node-next pointers at +0xC0. For each node, calls sub_546450(node, -1); on a non-zero return (match found) returns -1 immediately. Otherwise decrements the global Addend atomically via InterlockedDecrement and runs AudioVolumeLoadComputation(0), then advances to the next node. Returns 0 when the list is empty or the chain ends without a match.

operations.description: Load head pointer into v1 from this[9] (dword at byte offset 0x24).
If head pointer is null, return 0 (empty list, nothing to scan).
While sub_546450(current_node, -1) returns 0, keep walking the chain through each node's next pointer at +0xC0.
Call sub_546450(v1, -1); a non-zero return indicates the match that exits the loop.
Atomically decrement the global Addend via InterlockedDecrement (target address 0x0059E234).
Invoke AudioVolumeLoadComputation(0) as a side effect on the non-match path.
Advance v1 to the next node read from the current node's +0xC0 pointer.
If the next node pointer is null, return 0 (chain ended without a match).
Return -1 when a node matches sub_546450's condition.

unresolved: Semantics of sub_546450's match condition are not resolved; it determines whether the walk returns -1 or continues.
Global 0x008B8EEC is only labelled Addend by the legacy ABI name; its role beyond being an interlocked counter is unproven.
Why each non-match also triggers AudioVolumeLoadComputation(0) is unresolved.
